name: Junius Fahrenheit
source:
Faction:	        Terran
Birthday:	        November 1, 2384
Place of Birth:	Unknown
Occupation:	Lieutenant Commander/Captain
Affiliation:	        United Terran Vanguard

Profile:
Despite having abruptly dropped out of the Lunar Military Academy at Mondshire, Junius Fahrenheit has at the young age of 22 served as a special liaison for Dr. Alexander Lomonosov at Novus Development Facility as well as several Sigil Corporation executives on Earth.

At the Academy, they earned a reputation for their superb tactical and operational sense, thanks to a keen mind capable of rapid assessment and unorthodox, unexpected strategies. They also have a firm grasp on the more theoretical aspects of space exploration, having spent time at research facilities in orbit around Venus.

Junius was eventually promoted to the rank of Captain of the experimental United Terran Vanguard (UTV) battleship “Sierra” after the first battle at Mondshire.
translation:
阵营：地球人
生日：2384年11月1日
出生地：未知
职业：中校／舰长
所属：联合地球先锋队

简介：
尽管朱尼厄斯·华氏突然从蒙德郡月球军事学院退学，22岁时便已担任诺弗斯开发设施亚历山大·罗蒙诺索夫博士及地球数名西格尔公司高管的特别联络员。

在学院期间，他凭借敏锐头脑、快速判断能力，以及非正统而出人意料的策略，赢得了卓越的战术与作战才能声誉。他还精通太空探索的理论知识，曾在环绕金星的研究设施工作。

蒙德郡首战后，他最终晋升为实验性联合地球先锋队（UTV）战舰“塞拉”号的舰长。
